overview.description: The Goldman Sachs MSCI World Private Equity Return Tracker ETF (GTPE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is not private equity, it is attempting to replicate the performance returns of the space. The fund aims to track an index which comprises long and short positions in publicly listed stocks, globally GTPE was launched on Oct 21, 2025 and is issued by Goldman Sachs.
